answer: The system gives weight only to identities with a proof-of-history chain of 10 graded epochs over 30 days, each answer linked to the prior one and 1 in 10 old answers randomly re-graded, so each fake must build its own chain. At enrollment the operator burns wood down to one ember and records its burn time, measures a pigment sample and records its color value, and carries the sample across a river on a 30-meter crossing in one trip. A value that differs on re-check, or a failed re-grade, zeroes weight, so 100 fakes need 100 30-day chains.
